classes.INSTRUMENTATION_ARTIFACT: logging/timing itself changes, loses, or misattributes the outcome
classes.HARNESS_OR_ORACLE_ARTIFACT: gate is nondeterministic, invalid, or not entailed by frozen contract
classes.ENVIRONMENT_LIMITATION: missing/unavailable dependency, service, resource, credential, or platform outside candidate control
classes.SPECIFICATION_INTENT_FAILURE: task contract is ambiguous, inconsistent, or incorrectly represented
classes.CONTEXT_FAILURE: required repository fact was not acquired
classes.ARCHITECTURAL_UNDERSTANDING_FAILURE: known context was mapped to boundaries/consequences incorrectly
classes.IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE: candidate does not implement an entailed requirement
classes.REVIEW_FAILURE: review incorrectly accepts/rejects or misses a detectable defect
classes.FOCUSED_VALIDATION_FAILURE: valid task gate detects candidate failure
classes.REPOSITORY_VALIDATION_FAILURE: valid broad gate detects repository consequence
classes.STRUCTURAL_VALIDATION_FAILURE: valid structural gate detects boundary/invariant failure
classes.COORDINATION_APPROVAL_FAILURE: selection, handoff, conflict, or approval prevents acceptance
classes.STOPPING_CENSORED: cap reached before result; not itself assigned as causal failure

rules: Classify first failure and terminal cause separately
Two blinded adjudicators use frozen task, logs, and oracle-entailment map; disagreement goes to a third adjudicator
Artifact and environment classes do not count as task-stage failures but remain diagnostic and trigger exclusion/block rules
A failed assertion is not automatically candidate failure
Rework records origin class and detection stage separately
Never relabel after viewing condition aggregate; corrections require an auditable reason
